question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you know what Cameron wants to tell Emily?
Are you excited for the next episode?

nodes.text: He types out `be there soon!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: He types out [b]be there soon!!![/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There... Maybe Emily can stall the bus long enough for me to say goodbye.
Ben looks up just in time to see a huge patch of wet tile in front of him...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa!
He instinctively leaps over it, landing on the dry patch on the other side.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Phew!
They ride in silence for a while, until Cameron finally breaks it.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I have to tell you something... Something personal.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... You're not just here to see how I'm doing?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No, that was a... Ruse.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Nice word, Cameron! I didn't know you had that in you.
Cameron playfully goes slack-jawed, his eyelids drooping.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Uhhhhhhng... Wooooooords hard for dumb jock!
Emily laughs!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hahaha!
That's when she notices that the other girls are all shooting glares at her.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh oh. The girls must think I was flirting with Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait... Why is `Sam` angry with me? Does this mean...? She and Cameron?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Why is [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam[/i][/color] angry with me? Does this mean...? She and Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Anyway, what I wanted to say was--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Look, Cameron, I'm not interested.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What? But--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm just not in the mood to hear this right now, okay?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah, I get it. Sure.
They ride the rest of the way without speaking.
As the sun begins to set on the day, the bus pulls into the campsite.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: We're here! Everybody meet outside in five for a team meeting!
Emily tries to get up from her seat, but Hannah steps into the aisle at the same time, knocking her back down.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whoops! Didn't see you there, Em!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, this is going to be a lot of fun.
Emily tries to cross her legs away from Cameron, but she bangs her foot on the seat in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ow!
Instinctively, Cameron reaches out and touches her leg.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm fine.
Emily tries to move her leg, but it's wedged in!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Here.
Cameron grabs her leg and frees it for her.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Swim much, Em? Your leg is crazy strong.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Thanks...
Emily gulps and looks out the window.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Smooth, Emily. Try to brush him off, give him a grand tour of your leg...
Emily crosses her arms over her chest... She stares out the window.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Uh... So I guess you're... Fine, then?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's what I said.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm fine with you being fine then... I guess.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Anyway, what I wanted to know is... Do you think Cameron's hooked up with `every` girl on the swim team... Or just me and Jane?
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, what I wanted to know is... Do you think Cameron's hooked up with [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] girl on the swim team... Or just me and Jane?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you serious? Not only is that gross, but I don't think that's really any of my business...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know Amanda would `never` cheat on Hector.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know Amanda would [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] cheat on Hector.

nodes.text: Emily notices Amanda across the aisle reading what appears to be a candy bar wrapper.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And I know you're in the clear. Cameron wouldn't be interested in a little freshman like you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Gee, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm worried about Sam the most. She's been with a lot of guys. And she's always really cold to Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What does her being cold have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Haven't you been listening? That's `exactly` how Jane acted toward him before they hooked up.
nodes.text_bbcode: Haven't you been listening? That's [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] how Jane acted toward him before they hooked up.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But Sam acts like that with everyone. Don't you think you're just being paranoid?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I think I'd know if I was being paranoid, Em. I just wanted your opinion.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You might not think it, but I'm totally laid back about Cameron.
Just then, Cameron gets up from his seat at the front of the bus.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ohmygod! He's coming over here! Ohmygod!
Hannah pushes Emily out into the aisle.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Get out of here!
Emily sits in the seat across from Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yep. Totally laid back.
Meanwhile, closer to the front of the bus, Cameron walks past Jane...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oh, uh, hey, Cameron. I'm excited to spend some time together on this trip.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah, I am too...
Jane slides over in her seat, making room for Cameron, but he keeps on walking.
Then he crosses Hannah's path. Hannah tries her best to casually advertise the open seat next to her.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey, Cameron.
But instead Cameron turns to Emily!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Mind if I sit next to you?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Heh. Can I sit here?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I... I guess.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's enough of an invitation for me.
Cameron sits, his bare leg brushing for a moment against Emily's.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sorry. Tight fit. This bus is like a sardine can.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't freak out! That doesn't mean he's hitting on you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Um, what's up?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Nothing. I just thought I'd see how you're doing...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And that's it?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: For now.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Just whatever you do, don't lead him on!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm fine.
Emily leans away from Cameron...
Emily gasps, attracting attention from the other swimmers!
Hannah quickly clamps her hand over Emily's mouth!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Something going on back there?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Mmmph!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mmmph![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Are you crazy?
Emily shakes her head, and Hannah lowers her hand.
Emily gasps, attracting attention from the other swimmers!
Hannah quickly clamps her hand over Emily's mouth!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Something going on back there?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Mmmph!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mmmph![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Are you crazy?
Emily shakes her head, and Hannah lowers her hand.
Emily keeps her cool.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Phew! I almost blurted out that Hannah made out with Cameron!
Instead, she whispers the first thing that comes to mind.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But what about you and Zach?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Please. I gave Zach all the time in the world to make a move, and he never did. I can't be single forever.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess you two have been friends for a long time now.
Emily gasps, attracting attention from the other swimmers!
Hannah quickly clamps her hand over Emily's mouth!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Something going on back there?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Mmmph!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mmmph![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Are you crazy?
Emily shakes her head, and Hannah lowers her hand.
Emily doesn't know how to react, so she blurts the first thing that comes to her mind.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You made out with--

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Emily! Let's go! We want to get there while there's still daylight!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I've gotta go, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want you to know that I...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Come on, Emily! Let's get a move on!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...I trust you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I've gotta go!
Emily climbs on the bus...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did she hear me?
The bus shifts gears and drives off, leaving Ben to wonder.
You are now playing as Emily.
Emily walks toward the back of the bus, looking for a seat.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben said he trusts me. That's one step closer to... To something more.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I just wish I hadn't been so rushed... I might have told him how much his trust means to me.
She finds an open seat next to Hannah and sits down. Hannah makes an annoyed sound with her teeth.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Um... Sitting?
Hannah's voice drops to a whisper.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm trying to get Cameron to sit there!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What? Should I move then?
Emily starts to get up, but Hannah pulls her back down.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait! Now it'll be weird if you leave! Besides, I need your objective opinion on some major dirt.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: First, backstory.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?
Hannah nods toward the front of the bus where Jane is reading a book entitled `'The Amazon in You'`.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hannah nods toward the front of the bus where Jane is reading a book entitled [b]'The Amazon in You'[/b].

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: She and Cameron totally hooked up on our last swim team trip.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: They did? I thought Jane hated Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know! That's just it! There's something about him...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's like, when he talks to you, all your hate melts away under the gaze of those perfect blue eyes.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Right... Hate-melting eyes...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Anyway, here's where it gets good!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You `have` to keep quiet about this...
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to keep quiet about this...

nodes.text: Hannah leans closer to Emily.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yesterday, Cameron and I... `Made out!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yesterday, Cameron and I... [color=#3b78e2][i]Made out![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: His reputation?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I've heard rumors about him... That he's hooked up with a lot of girls on the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben Kale! Are you jealous?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I just don't like the idea of the two of you interacting... In any way, shape, or form.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That is kind of the definition of jealousy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Then, yes. I guess I'm jealous.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, don't be. First of all, even though Cameron looks like a Greek God...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not helping...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hooking up with a lot of girls is a major turn off.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Second of all, I'm `your` girlfriend for a reason.
nodes.text_bbcode: Second of all, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] girlfriend for a reason.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's because I look like an even `Greeker` God, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's because I look like an even [color=#e23b3b][i]Greeker[/i][/color] God, right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee. Something like that...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: My safety?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah, you know, the woods. Bears. Wild badgers.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's not what's on your mind, is it?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because even though my dad is finally starting to lighten up a little bit... He's still, like, the prison warden of Overprotection Island.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why don't you tell me what's really going on?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's... It's...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I tell her I'm jealous, it'll be like telling her I'm insecure!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's nothing. Really.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine... You don't have to tell me if you don't want to.
Ben walks over to Emily...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How did you get out of Mr. Dean's class?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Out of the kindness of his literature loving heart, he let me have the day off...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh huh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's just the kind of close teacher-student relationship Mr. Dean and I have.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You expect me to believe that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No. But the truth is a whole lot lamer.
Nearby, Ben and Emily are interrupted by laughter from the guys' swim team!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Oh man, I totally forgot about that!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That was so funny I almost threw up!
Cameron calls over to Emily.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Emily, we were just talking about how Coach made us swim in our school clothes...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: All because Lee forgot his swim gear!
Emily laughs.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee! I `do` remember that. I also remember Zach arguing so that he could swim naked.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee! I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] remember that. I also remember Zach arguing so that he could swim naked.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Oh yeah, that was weird, man.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What's wrong with being proud of my body?!
Cameron flashes a smile at Emily.
For Ben, the smile lasts for too long.
Emily turns her attention back to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What is it, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Emily, I'm not sure how I feel about you going on this trip.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just... I'm just worried about...
...In a line, about to board the bus!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Huff... Puff...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Barely made it...
Ben bursts out through the library doors, races down the stairs, and out into the parking lot where the swim teams are...
He leaps onto the table without breaking stride! The nerds gasp!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Coming through!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Ben! Think you can...?
Ben leaps off the other end of the table and sprints toward the library's exit.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...Help us?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: That was cool!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: And weird. I wonder why he's in such a rush...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What if `he's` traveling at normal speed, and we're in some kind of time vortex?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What if [color=#e23b3b][i]he's[/i][/color] traveling at normal speed, and we're in some kind of time vortex?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: If I have to hear about your time vortex theory `one` more time!
nodes.text_bbcode: If I have to hear about your time vortex theory [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] more time!

nodes.text: Ben tries to run around the table, but Erik unwittingly stands up, his chair impeding Ben's progress.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Benjamin! Mr. Chemistry! Just the guy I wanted to see!
Ben tries to shuffle around the other end of the table, but Kevin stands, blocking him.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: This book is preposterous! It has almost no diagrams and rarely provides concrete at-home experiments for testing hypotheses!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, I would love to help you, but I kind of have to...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Plus, it's boring! There's no imagination or humor! Just long blocks of text about bonds and atoms and...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Guys! I really need to get by! I'm sorry I can't help you!
Kevin moves aside...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Sorry for... Wanting your help.
Ben starts to run past...  But he stops himself, sighs, and turns back around.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you really want a good Chemistry book, check out `Chemistry for Today's Mad Scientists`. It'll blow your mind.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you really want a good Chemistry book, check out [color=#e23b3b][i]Chemistry for Today's Mad Scientists[/i][/color]. It'll blow your mind.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huh-ho! I've always wanted to be an angry scientist! Where are my beakers? I can't prove anything without my beakers!
Ben runs off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That took way too long!
Ben hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I'll just go around...
He tries to text 'be there soon' but when he looks at his phone, it says 'butt the scone!!!'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not right at all!
As he tries to delete the text, he slams right into an open locker!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ow!
He crashes to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Should not text while doing anything else...
Spencer looks down at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That was awesome! I just wish I'd filmed it on my phone! Do it again, dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Shut up, Spence, and help me up.
Spencer helps Ben to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm late for class, man. Catch you later... But just know that you made my day.
Ben checks his phone, discovering that he accidentally sent the text before he could delete any of it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great. 'Butt the scone'. Exactly how I wanted to say goodbye to my girlfriend.
In the hallway...
Ben pulls out his phone as he sprints along the rows and rows of lockers and tries to text as he runs!
Some of the other students snicker.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: What? That's ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, they are on a raft, so...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: No! No! `No,` Mr. Kale!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! No! [color=#e23b3b][i]No,[/i][/color] Mr. Kale!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: You've missed the point entirely! And you're not to make a mockery of my classroom... Not again!
Ben raises his hand again...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look I know this is bad timing, but uh, could I use the restroom?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: No! Absolutely not! If anything you need to spend `more` time in my class!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Absolutely not! If anything you need to spend [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] time in my class!

nodes.text: Mr. Dean turns his back to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's worth it!
Ben rushes out of the classroom!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Mr. Kale?! Mr. Kale?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Very good. It is their `friendship` that keeps them together on the raft.
nodes.text_bbcode: Very good. It is their [color=#e23b3b][i]friendship[/i][/color] that keeps them together on the raft.

nodes.text: As Huck learns about Jim, he begins to see him as a human being, and they start to `trust` each other.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Powerful stuff.
Ben raises his hand again...
Score Up!

nodes.text: Mr. Dean? Could I use the restroom?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Yes! Of course! Of course!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Never mind. Miracle. I'm cured.
Ben rushes out of the classroom!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Dean
nodes.text: Mr. Kale? Are you planning on answering during this class period?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Even if we aren't headed to the top as a team, we all still have to get there.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Let's just go, okay?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sure.
A little while later...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We finally made it past all those boulders.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I was thinking now might be a good time for me to tell you what I've been trying to tell you since we left.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know what you're going to say...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And I know you know I'm Ben's girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I do. What does that have to do with--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Personally, I think it's really despicable of you to flirt with me even when you know I'm taken.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Flirting with you?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah! It's like you're not showing any respect for my relationship with Ben.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I haven't--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Let me get through this!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Fine. Go ahead.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You've really messed things up! All the girls hate me now! And why?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Because you just `had` to hit on me on the bus!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because you just [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to hit on me on the bus!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And by the way, Sam told me about how you used to have a thing for Sara!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So I completely get what's going on here! You couldn't get with her so you're trying to get with me!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well just like with her, I've got too much self-respect! It isn't going to happen!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Are you done?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sure. Go ahead.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You think I've been flirting with you?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What do you call the look you just gave me when you pulled me up over the boulder?
Cameron sighs.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I haven't been flirting with you, and I'm really sorry if that's what's caused all the grief between you and the other girls.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I looked at you the way I did just now because in the light, you looked just like her.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You looked just like Sara.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And what I've wanted to say to you is...
Cameron stops talking as they crest over the top of a ridge, walking out onto a windy plateau.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Is...? Go ahead?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Emily, look at where we are.
Emily sees. They're at the top of the mountain, but they're all alone!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Where's the swim team? Where's the flag? Where's my dad?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You know what this means, right?
Emily nods solemnly.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We're lost...

nodes.text: What are you looking at?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm fine. I could just use a little help, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: This is hopeless! I'm never going to make it over this thing!
After a few more failed attempts to climb the boulder, Emily hears footsteps approaching...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Emily? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily

nodes.speaker: Emily

nodes.speaker: Emily

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hannah! Come back here!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Help! Please!

nodes.speaker: Emily

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Cameron! Please help! Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Emily

A little while later, Emily hears footsteps approaching!

nodes.speaker: Emily

Emily hears nothing except the sound of the wind blowing through the trees...

nodes.speaker: Emily

nodes.speaker: Emily

Emily hears nothing except the sound of the wind blowing through the trees...

Without another word, he climbs into the bus and drives off!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No offense, Emily, but sometimes your dad really sucks.

nodes.speaker: Emily

A half an hour later, the swimmers have spread out along the trail.
Zach and Lee lead out front...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I never thought I'd say this, but I miss the cafeteria's food!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And I never thought I'd say this, but I miss Cowboy Burger!
Followed closely behind by Sam and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: { Going to the mountain! Going to the mountain! Gonna eat some s'mores! {

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, Amanda, but...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What is it? Am I in the dreamworld again?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never mind. Just, I like your voice.

nodes.speaker: Amanda

Cameron silently follows behind them...
And Hannah and Jane keep in close proximity to him.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey, Cameron, I like your hiking boots.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hey, Cameron, did you get a chance to read any more?
Bringing up the rear, Emily tries to ignore the glares that Hannah and Jane routinely shoot back at her.
A little after sunrise, the trail turns steep and narrow. Massive boulders make steady progress difficult.
Emily loses sight of everyone except Hannah and Jane.
Turning the corner, the trail is blocked by a particularly large boulder!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I'll go first.
Jane scampers up. She turns around and holds out her arm, helping Hannah climb up.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wow. I wish I was as agile as you, Jane.
Emily reaches the base of the boulder. She tries to climb up, but slips.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey! I can't get up. Can you give me a hand?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Did you hear something, Jane?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Must be the wind...
Emily hears them talking as they climb away...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You're angry with her too? Why?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh... It's complicated.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I've never going to be able to climb this on my own! I need help! Who should I call for?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I've warned you about calling me Dad before!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know. I know. I said was sorry.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Good. And to answer your question...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: No, I'm not being too extreme. Extreme would be kicking all of you off the relay team and letting some of the other freshmen have a chance!
The swimmers go totally silent.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Why'd I even bother calling him Dad?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're my Coach, and I get that, but I'm appealing you to right now as my father.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you sure this is safe?
Emily's father's stern look melts away, for just a second. He stares at the mountain in the distance...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Want to tone it down a notch?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But yes, I'm sure you'll all be safe!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: At least do me a favor and prolong it from happening.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And how am I supposed to do that?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Stay away from Cameron.
Jane stiffens as footsteps approach from behind Emily.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Speak of the devil...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Jane. Hey, Emily.
Jane steps between Cameron and Emily.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hey, Cameron. Have you read `'The Amazon in You'` yet?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Cameron. Have you read [color=#3b78e2][i]'The Amazon in You'[/i][/color] yet?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm still working on it.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Actually, if you don't mind, Jane, there's something I've been meaning to talk to Emily about.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Emily just told me that she's really tired and couldn't stay awake for another minute. Isn't that right, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah... That's... True.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oh... I guess it can wait then. Tomorrow?
Emily looks from Cameron's expectant face to Jane's angry one.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I've... I've gotta go.
Emily hurries off to her tent...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Between the girls and Cameron, everything's so awkward now!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'd give anything to just go home!
The next morning, Coach Kessler wakes everyone up before daylight breaks!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, listen up. You see those mountains over there? That one in the middle? That's Mount Collins.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm going to drive to the base and hike up to the top. You're all going to hike over to it this morning.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You'll be able to find me easily because I'll be flying the school flag.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: We have a flag?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All of you are going to have ample food and water, compasses, and a couple of maps.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Your job is to get everyone to the top of the mountain quickly `and safely.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Your job is to get everyone to the top of the mountain quickly [color=#e23b3b][i]and safely.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Worst. Trip. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Will there be hot dogs there?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What is the point?!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: The point is teamwork!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't you think this is a bit extreme, Dad?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: `Coach.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Coach.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm mad at you for... For, I don't know... Stealing my backpack in the future!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oh, real original. That's stupid.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How is it any different from what you're doing?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I told you! Once Cameron has his sights on you, he's impossible to resist! It's only a matter of time.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well maybe now that I've given you the idea to steal my backpack, it's also inevitable...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You thief!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Doesn't feel very good, does it?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No, it doesn't. I guess... I guess it isn't fair of me to judge you for something you haven't done yet. I'm sorry for that.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So then, you're not mad at me anymore?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No, I'm still mad at you. I just feel bad about it now.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm not going to be able to change your mind.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: So you just accept that what I'm saying is true!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What? No, that's not what I--

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sheesh. Have a backbone, Emily! At least challenge what I'm saying!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: My anger is, like, completely irrational, and you just let me get away with it?!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Where's your self-respect? Where's your womanly strength? Where's your inner Amazon?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So, wait, are you still mad at me?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Are you serious? I'm even angrier than I was before!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Before I was mad about what you were going to do, but now I'm mad about that `and` I'm mad about how pathetically you reacted!
nodes.text_bbcode: Before I was mad about what you were going to do, but now I'm mad about that [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] I'm mad about how pathetically you reacted!

nodes.text: Emily begrudgingly catches Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Thanks, Em! That was `so` thrilling!
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks, Em! That was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] thrilling!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And I bet you feel like closer teammates already.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do I ever.
Hannah crashes onto the ground with a hard thud!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hannah! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: My back!
Coach Kessler kneels down, checking to make sure Hannah's injury isn't severe.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You should be okay, you'll just have a nasty bruise.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ow! It hurts!
He stands and turns to Emily.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You let her fall on purpose!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So what if I did?! She dropped `me` on the ground!
nodes.text_bbcode: So what if I did?! She dropped [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's no excuse!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm so disappointed in you. If your teammates can't trust you... Then...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then you're not on the team anymore!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! But I'm the best swimmer on the team!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Correction. You `were` the best swimmer on the team. You can sit on the bus for the rest of the weekend!
nodes.text_bbcode: Correction. You [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] the best swimmer on the team. You can sit on the bus for the rest of the weekend!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine!
Emily marches off toward the bus!
Later, in one of the seats, Emily stares out the window at the other swimmers as they fall into each other's arms, laughing together.
Emily imagines the rest of her high school life without swimming and she realizes one simple fact...
Emily freezes!
She feels the rush of adrenaline as gravity whips her down toward the ground!
Right at the moment of impact... Hannah catches her! Emily's eyes pop open!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Phew! Thanks for catching me...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No problem. I kind of had to. But now that I've caught you, nothing says I have to keep holding you up.
Hannah lets go, dropping Emily on her butt!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oof!
Emily stands, dusting herself off.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: My turn to catch `you` now.
nodes.text_bbcode: My turn to catch [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] now.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey, Coach Kessler! Watch me and Emily?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sure.
Emily's father comes over and watches as Hannah stands in front of Emily...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Here I go! You'll catch me right, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'll do something.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Of course she will. You just have to trust her.
Hannah closes her eyes, folds her arms over her body, and leans back, falling toward Emily!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No. I'm not going to fall.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aww, but now I don't have the fun of dropping, er, catching you.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What's going on over there, girls?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't trust Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She's your teammate. You have to trust her.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But I don't! I'm not going to fall because I know she's just going to drop me!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Emily Kessler, if you don't trust your teammates, then you cannot be a part of this team.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Are you going to do the trust fall?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Not if it means getting dropped on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then I guess you're not on the team anymore!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! But I'm your daughter!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's what makes this so disappointing!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine! I'm still the best swimmer on the team!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Correction. You `were` the best swimmer on the team. You can sit on the bus for the rest of the weekend!
nodes.text_bbcode: Correction. You [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] the best swimmer on the team. You can sit on the bus for the rest of the weekend!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine!
Emily marches off toward the bus!
Later, in one of the seats, Emily stares out the window at the other swimmers as they fall into each other's arms, laughing together.
Emily imagines the rest of her high school life without swimming, and she realizes one simple fact...
Emily hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you're definitely not interested in him?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm interested in Ben. That's why he's my `boyfriend.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm interested in Ben. That's why he's my [color=#3b78e2][i]boyfriend.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I understand why you might be upset. It's just when it comes to Cameron... He sort of overrides that whole committed relationship thing.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Apparently.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait... Why are you so concerned about this then?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because it... It bothers me, okay? That he's interested in you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Me and Cameron? There is no `me and Cameron.` There's no me and anyone!
nodes.text_bbcode: Me and Cameron? There is no [color=#3b78e2][i]me and Cameron.[/i][/color] There's no me and anyone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or are you so out of it that you didn't know that I've pretty much sworn off guys?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well... I mean, I knew that. But why else would you be angry with me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe because I don't think you should be flirting with him.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: He just started talking to me, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sure that's `all` he's interested in... Talking.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure that's [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] he's interested in... Talking.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why do you think he's `talking` to you, Emily?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why do you think he's [color=#3b78e2][i]talking[/i][/color] to you, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's one of those guys who goes after `every` girl.
nodes.text_bbcode: He's one of those guys who goes after [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] girl.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What do you want me to do, Sam? I tried to brush him off. I did everything short of pushing him onto the floor!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Duh.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, there is no `me and Cameron.` Period.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there is no [color=#3b78e2][i]me and Cameron.[/i][/color] Period.

nodes.text: Outside, both swim teams gather around Coach Kessler...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, I bet all of you are itching to have a relaxing getaway weekend with your teammates.
Both teams let out hearty cheers!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh yeah, Coach K! And to eat as many hot dogs as possible!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I can't wait to swim in the lake!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I love lake!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sounds like you're very excited! Is that right?

nodes.speaker: Everyone
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Well `none` of that's going to happen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well [color=#e23b3b][i]none[/i][/color] of that's going to happen!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no. What are you doing now, Dad?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Not until you can all prove to me that you can function together `as a team!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not until you can all prove to me that you can function together [color=#e23b3b][i]as a team![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But that's not fair! We've all set personal bests in our events!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And yet we are completely abysmal in the relay! I'm sick of watching us finish dead last every time!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It isn't due to lack of talent. It's team dissonance, infighting, and complacency.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's my fault! My responsibility! And it ends this weekend!
The swimmers groan, but one look from Emily's father silences them.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: For now, we're going to set up camp. We'll start by pairing up!
Emily's father randomly assigns everyone to a partner. When he reaches Sam...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sam, you're with Emily! I want all of you working `with` your partners when setting up your tents!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, you're with Emily! I want all of you working [color=#e23b3b][i]with[/i][/color] your partners when setting up your tents!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Well... What are you waiting for? Get to it!
A moment later, Emily and Sam are standing in a clear space, their disassembled tent lying on the dirt.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... Should we start by hammering stakes through these corner loops?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got a lot of nerve.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I... I know you're angry with me about something.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I saw the look on your face back on the bus. Does this have something to do with...

nodes.prompt: Does this have something to do with...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Does this have something to do with...

nodes.text: His phone vibrates again with another text from Emily.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: ur coming here? i'll try to stall!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's my girl!

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Joke? Did u sit on a scone? i dont get it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just... Hang on!
Ben darts left and...
...Cuts through the library!
Up ahead, two nerds sit on either side of a long table that blocks his path!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know about you, Kev, but this section on chemistry is confounding!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: No joke.
Ben reaches the table and...
Emily's father catches Ben with a stern gaze.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What are you doing here, Ben? Shouldn't you be in class?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'd hate to have you lie to me after our delightful dinner the other day...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...I ditched it. To be honest, I really wanted to see your daughter before she goes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hmph. I can't fault your devotion. Say what you need to say and head on back to class.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks.
Cameron extends an arm down and pulls Emily up.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Didn't Jane or Hannah offer to help?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That would be the right thing to do.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But they're not exactly friends with me right now.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Thanks, by the way...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So much for the team getting to the top together, right?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I guess our chemistry's off.
Cameron's eyes meet hers and for a second, she's completely and utterly caught by them.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right! It's getting dark. Everyone get in your tents in half an hour for bed.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What? But it's not even night yet!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're going to want a good night's sleep. We'll be up early tomorrow for something a lot bigger than tents and trust falls.
As the swimmers unpack their things from the bus, Emily approaches Jane.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, Jane.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: What do `you` want?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] want?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I just wanted to clear the air between us. I think you've got the wrong impression about me.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oh, I think I've got exactly the `right` impression about you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I think I've got exactly the [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] impression about you.

nodes.speaker: Jane
